The '''Illodian Officers' Academy''' trained officers for [[Illodia]]'s famed system defense force. [[Avan Beruss]] trained in flying [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], and other small craft there.
